demo-audio.label: Say hello
demo-audio.oneSubmissionNote: This is a demonstration activity, not a qualification assessment.

preferred.label: 1 short audio introduction
preferred.instruction: Introduce yourself in a few sentences, or introduce someone who is happy to take part.

alternatives.label: Written alternative
alternatives.instruction: If you cannot record audio, write the same short introduction instead.

capture: Keep the introduction brief and natural.
Do not include private information you would not normally share.

demo-photo.label: Take a photo
demo-photo.oneSubmissionNote: This demonstrates how Evia captures photo evidence.

preferred.label: 1 clear photo
preferred.instruction: Take one clear photo of someone who has agreed to be included. If you are alone, take a photo of something interesting nearby instead.

capture: Ask permission before photographing another person.
Keep confidential paperwork, screens and personal information out of view.

demo-video.label: Rock, paper, scissors
demo-video.oneSubmissionNote: This demonstrates how Evia captures short practical video evidence.

preferred.label: 1 short video
preferred.instruction: Record one quick round of rock, paper, scissors. If you are alone, demonstrate the three hand signs and explain the rules instead.

capture: Make sure everyone being recorded is happy to take part.

demo-written.label: Your verdict
demo-written.oneSubmissionNote: There is no right answer. The point is to try Evia's written evidence workflow.

preferred.label: 1 short written response
preferred.instruction: Write a few sentences saying which Evia feature you think would be most useful to a learner and why.

alternatives.label: Audio alternative
alternatives.instruction: Record a short audio response instead if you would rather speak than type.

capture: Choose one feature that stood out to you.
Give a simple reason for your choice.
